goals.description: Detached run context helper: context.WithoutCancel(reqCtx) plus its own timeout budget, surviving the originating request's cancellation
Per-run Hub: topic per RunID, bounded ring buffer for replay-on-reattach, bounded per-subscriber channel
Slow-subscriber drop: Publish never blocks on a full subscriber channel — drops that subscriber instead
Reattach/disconnect lifecycle: Subscribe returns a replay slice + live channel + idempotent unsubscribe; Hub can Close a run's topic (all subscribers see a closed channel)

Tests covering: basic delivery, replay after a given seq, ring-buffer eviction, slow-subscriber drop without blocking Publish, unsubscribe (incl. double-unsubscribe safety), topic Close, detached context surviving parent cancellation, detached context's own timeout firing. All 10 tests pass under plain go test; the -race portion specifically is blocked
goals.plan_ref: 03-backend-folder-architecture.md §8 testing table ('Concurrency: hub_test.go — -race: cancellation, subscriber drop, lease contention')
goals.blocked_reason: go test -race requires cgo; this environment has CGO_ENABLED=0 and no C compiler (gcc/clang) installed, so the race detector cannot run here at all, for any package. Not a code issue — the concurrency design was reviewed manually instead (see validate.json) and TestHub_ConcurrentPublishSubscribe exercises concurrent Publish/Subscribe without a race detector present to confirm it.
